summary: Structural schema conformance: builds backend-neutral conform expressions for a TableSchema (_build_conform_exprs / resolve_conform_output), models the per-dimension ConformContract (extra_columns, missing_columns, data_type, keys), reports drift (ConformDrift, ConformCollection), and carries structured-field transport plans. Called by Relation.conform() and the DAG visitor; validation owns value-level checks instead.
key_classes: ConformContract — unified per-dimension reconciliation contract (fields_match presets expand into it)
ConformOutputContract — resolved output shape of a conform
ConformResult / FieldBuildResult — outputs of expression building
ConformDrift / TypeDrift / ColumnDrift / KeyDrift — drift report data shapes
ConformCollection — collected frame plus drift report (collect_with_drift)
StructuredFieldPlan — frozen plan for physical-to-logical structured field transport
OperationDiagnosticTrace — diagnostics carried from compilation to materialization
ConformError hierarchy — MissingFieldsError, ExtraFieldsError, SchemaDriftError, etc.
key_functions: resolve_conform_output(...) — single reconciler producing the conform output from a contract
resolve_contract(...) / validate_contract_dict(...) — build and validate a ConformContract
_build_conform_exprs(schema, ...) — internal builder shared by Relation.conform() and the DAG visitor
extension_points: ConformContract dimension modes (extra_columns, missing_columns, data_type, keys) and FIELDS_MATCH_PRESETS
lifecycle_notes: c3578b97 and ea16cb8e: container cast execution against resolved targets and structured transport qualification.
c5fb334f retained conform fill policies and temporal cast cardinality.
Governed by principles build-then-conform and conform-contract (ADOPTED); earlier note: conform needs compile-time column detection (ConformRelNode).
documentation_hooks: Conforming a relation to a TableSchema
fields_match modes and ConformContract policy dimensions
risks: Error family depends on provenance: preset-derived contracts raise legacy fields_match errors, explicit layers raise SchemaDriftError.
Open mode column detection cannot be decided at build time without compile-time schema knowledge.
Cross-backend temporal/decimal/list casting behaviours are heavily tested and subject to backend divergence.
